scope: six provided synthetic fixed vectors; all two budgets; exact randomization MSE; no global guarantee

config.primary_endpoint: exact MSE over sampling randomness, not Monte Carlo MSE
config.allocation: half budget to positive-history stratum, capacity adjusted, at least one each
config.budget_rule: every read of a current position including repeats costs one
config.tuning: fixed before full run; C_strata revision follows minimum-check rejection of C_mix dominance
